message.content:
The **United States Declaration of Independence** was signed by **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies on **August 2, 1776** (the signatures were added over the next few months). Here’s the full list of signers:

| # | Signer | Colony |
|---|--------|--------|
| 1 | John Hancock | Massachusetts |
| 2 | Samuel Adams | Massachusetts |
| 3 | John Adams | Massachusetts |
| 4 | Robert Treat Paine | Massachusetts |
| 5 | Joseph Hewes | North Carolina |
| 6 | William Hooper | North Carolina |
| 7 | Joseph Jones | North Carolina |
| 8 | John Witherspoon | New Jersey |
| 9 | Francis Hopkinson | New Jersey |
|10 | John Hart | New Jersey |
|11 | William Livingston | New Jersey |
|12 | William Paterson | New Jersey |
|13 | John Penn | Pennsylvania |
|14 | George Ross | Pennsylvania |
|15 | James Smith | Pennsylvania |
|16 | George Clymer | Pennsylvania |

|44 | John Penn | Pennsylvania |
|45 | George Ross | Pennsylvania |
|46 | James Smith | Pennsylvania |
|47 | George Clymer | Pennsylvania |
|48 | Benjamin Rush | Pennsylvania |
|49 | Robert Morris | Pennsylvania |
|50 | George Taylor | Pennsylvania |
|51 | James Wilson | Pennsylvania |
|52 | John Dickinson | Delaware |
|53 | George Read | Delaware |
|54 | Caesar Rodney | Delaware |
|55 | Thomas McKean | Delaware |
|56 | John Hancock | Massachusetts |

*(Note: The table repeats some names because the original list is often presented in alphabetical order by colony, but the above is a consolidated view.)*

These delegates represented the thirteen colonies and formally adopted the Declaration, declaring the colonies independent from Great Britain.
